name: The Song of Patroclus
source:
The Song of Patroclus short visual novel depicting the story of Achilles and Patroclus in a new, cyberpunk inspired world. 

[From [url=https://n0no.itch.io/the-song-of-patroclus]Itch.io[/url]]

[来自[url=https://n0no.itch.io/the-song-of-patroclus]Itch.io[/url]]
